description: Registry of executable capabilities. Every entrypoint is a public function in uiux.api; adapters call tools only through uiux.api.call_tool or the unified CLI (python scripts/uiux_cli.py call <id>). `input` is the JSON Schema subset enforced by uiux.core.schema before every call. `output.required` lists the top-level keys every successful result contains. `annotations` are platform-neutral upper bounds over all argument values: read_only, writes_to (none|target-project), may_start_process, deterministic, network_access, filesystem_read (package|target-project|browser-cache), requires_node, requires_browser, long_running.

tools.description: Turn a design requirement profile into a ranked capability plan (style, layouts, screens, motion, interactions, effects, technology, recipe anchor, retrieval list) with WHY / WHY NOT.

profile.description: Capability profile; fields and vocabularies in phase-2/capability-resolver/resolver.md#profile

output.description: Capability plan: style, layouts, screens, motion, interactions, effects, technology, recipe, guards, retrieval

tools.description: Query the knowledge registry (styles, layouts, screens, motion, interactions, effects, recipes, graphics, technologies, components) without knowing file locations.

output.description: {count, entries: [{id, kind, collection, category, name, file, line, summary, content?}]}

tools.description: Choose the simplest technology for capability ids: installed dependency, native platform, authorized library, native fallback, or degrade.
tools.side_effects: none; new dependencies are only recorded, never installed

tools.description: Static (and optional runtime-probe) evidence for design quality evals E65-E80.
Read-only capability detection for a target project, including Playwright readiness (NOT_DECLARED, DECLARED_NOT_INSTALLED, PACKAGE_AVAILABLE_BROWSER_MISSING, READY).

output.description: Capability report (runtime, package_manager, project, playwright.runtime_state, browser, accessibility, design_runtime, application)

tools.side_effects: none (read-only; runs `node --version`/`python --version`, optional HTTP GET to a given URL)

tools.description: Capture rendered evidence with the project's own Playwright (screenshots, optional motion probe and reduced-motion capture). Blocks honestly when the runtime is not ready.

allow_start.description: Allow starting the explicit argv start.command of the request

output.description: {exit_code, summary: {status, report?, manifest?}} with statuses COMPLETED, PARTIAL, FAILED, BLOCKED, DRY_RUN, INVALID_INPUT

runtime_requirements: project-local playwright or @playwright/test (optional; BLOCKED when absent)
installed Playwright browser build (optional; BLOCKED when absent)
tools.side_effects: writes evidence under <project>/.evidence/<session>; starts a server only with allow_start and an explicit argv command; never installs

tools.description: Run axe with the project's own Playwright and axe package against an already running application. Gated on playwright.runtime_state like run_runtime; blocks honestly (PLAYWRIGHT_IMPORT_FAILURE, PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSER_UNAVAILABLE, AXE_NOT_AVAILABLE, READINESS_TIMEOUT) and never installs, downloads or starts anything.

request.description: {session_id, base_url, routes, viewports?, iteration?, rules?, timeout_ms?, output_dir?}

output.description: {exit_code, summary: {status, manifest?, runtime_state?, error_code?}} with statuses COMPLETED, PARTIAL, FAILED, BLOCKED, DRY_RUN, INVALID_INPUT; exit codes 0 completed/dry-run, 2 blocked, 3 invalid input, 4 partial/failed

runtime_requirements: project-local playwright or @playwright/test (optional; BLOCKED when absent)
installed Playwright browser build (optional; BLOCKED when absent)
@axe-core/playwright or axe-core declared by the project (optional; BLOCKED when absent)
tools.side_effects: writes accessibility evidence under <project>/<output_dir>/<session>/accessibility (default .evidence); runs node for the axe helper; never installs, downloads browsers or starts a server

tools.description: Run automated eval suites (structure, knowledge, resolver, quality-fixtures) and list agent-run scenarios (scenarios suite, status MANUAL).
Whole-skill structural validation: required files, links, scenario IDs, contracts, knowledge catalogs, plugin-ready metadata.

Discover what this package can do: every manifest capability with its tools and instruction entrypoints, registered tools, knowledge collections, eval suites and optional runtime features. Static unless `project` is given, which adds runtime availability for that project (read-only detection).

project.description: Target project; when given, runtime-dependent capabilities report availability

output.description: {version, capabilities: {<id>: {kind: static|runtime-dependent, tools, instructions, availability}}, tools, knowledge, evals, runtime}

tools.side_effects: none; with `project`, the read-only runtime detection of detect_runtime

tools.description: Fast health check of the installed package: version consistency, manifest, tool/knowledge/error registries, public API entrypoints, capability map, error contract and runtime detection. A missing optional runtime is reported as BLOCKED, not as a failure.

output.description: {status: PASS|FAIL, version, checks: [{id, status: PASS|FAIL|BLOCKED, message, error_code?}]}

tools.side_effects: none (reads the package; runtime detection runs `node --version`); never installs, downloads or writes
